intellectual_tradition: 阳明心学/泰州学派/晚明启蒙思潮
description_zh: 李贽（1527-1602），初姓林，名载贽，后改姓李，字宏甫，号卓吾，又号温陵居士、龙湖叟。福建泉州晋江人，明朝万历年间著名思想家、文学家、史学家。他出身航海贸易世家，祖先有波斯湾通商背景。早年考取举人后多年担任低微官职，深受王阳明和泰州学派（罗汝芳）影响。晚年辞官，寄居湖北麻城芝佛院，从事写作和讲学十余年。他旗帜鲜明地以'异端'自居，提出'童心说''穿衣吃饭即是人伦物理'等革命性主张，批判程朱理学和传统儒家权威，反对'以孔子之是非为是非'，肯定个人私欲与功利价值。著作有《焚书》《藏书》《续焚书》《续藏书》等。万历三十年（1602年）以'敢倡乱道、惑世诬民'罪名被捕入狱，在狱中以剃刀自刎而死，享年76岁。其思想对晚明文人、日本明治维新、五四新文化运动均产生深远影响。
description_en: Li Zhi (1527-1602), originally surnamed Lin, named Zai Zhi, later changed to Li with the given name Zhi, courtesy name Hongfu, pseudonym Zhuo Wu (卓吾), also known as Wenling Jushi and Longhu Sou. From Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian, he was a prominent Ming Dynasty (Wanli period) thinker, writer, and historian. Born into a maritime trade family with Persian Gulf connections, he passed the provincial exam but held low-ranking posts for decades. Deeply influenced by Wang Yangming's philosophy and the Taizhou School (Luo Rufang), he resigned in his later years and lived in Zhifo Temple, Macheng, Hubei, where he wrote and taught for over a decade. He boldly identified as a 'heterodox' thinker, proposing revolutionary claims such as 'childlike mind is absolute authenticity' and 'dressing and eating constitute human ethics.' He critiqued Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism and traditional Confucian authority, opposing 'taking Confucius's judgments as standard,' and affirmed individual desires and utilitarian values. His works include 'Fenshu' (Books That Burning), 'Cangshu' (Books to Be Hidden), and their continuations. Arrested in 1602 on charges of 'daring to promote rebellious teachings and confuse the people,' he committed suicide by suicide with a razor in prison at age 76. His thought profoundly influenced late Ming literati, Japanese Meiji Restoration pioneers, and the May Fourth New Culture Movement.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M01童心法——绝假纯真的最初一念本心，以'童心'为判断一切价值的终极标准；M02穿衣吃饭法——物质生活即人伦物理，将道从日常生存中推导出来；M03异端法——主动拥抱'异端'标签，以批判者姿态否定传统权威（'不以孔子之是非为是非'）；M04真情法——强调真诚为本，反对道学家的虚伪矫饰（'阳为道学，阴为富贵'）；M05解放法——从儒家教条、礼法束缚中解放思想，主张思想自由和个性表达；M06实证法——以现实效用和实践效果检验真理，而非书本教条（'不言理财者决不能平治天下'）；M07个性法——肯定个体独特价值，反对千篇一律的人格塑造（特立独行、敢于自刎以全其志）；M08平等法——否定等级尊卑，主张男女平等、士庶无别（赞扬武则天为'圣后'，肯定卓文君善择佳耦）；M09自然法——顺应人的自然本性（'私者人之心也，人必有私而后其心乃见'），反对存天理灭人欲；M10反传统法——质疑和颠覆一切既定权威（孔孟经典、程朱理学），以'与世推移'的历史发展观取代保守主义。十大模式共同构成李贽独特的思想体系：以童心为起点、以穿衣吃饭为基础、以异端为立场、以真情为标准、以解放为目标、以实证为方法、以个性为表达、以平等为原则、以自然为本性、以反传统为武器。五大独特特征：批判先导性（以批判为思维起点）、物质本体论（将道拉回日常生存）、异端自觉（主动拥抱边缘身份）、真情伦理（内在真诚作为道德标准）、动态历史观（'与世推移'取代经典永恒论）。三大创新突破：十维一体批判体系（从童心到反传统的完整逻辑链）、晚明思想启蒙先驱（直接影响袁氏三兄弟、汤显祖，间接影响吉田松阴、五四新文化）、系统化的异端方法论（将批判本身理论化）。他是Protreptic中唯一将'反传统'本身系统化为方法论的思想家，是知识体系中关于批判性思维和思想解放的核心案例。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M01 Childlike Mind Method — absolute authenticity as the ultimate standard for judging all values; M02 Material Praxis Method — material life constitutes human ethics, deriving 'Dao' from daily survival needs; M03 Heterodox Method — actively embracing the 'heterodox' label to negate traditional authority ('do not take Confucius's judgments as standard'); M04 Authenticity Method — emphasizing genuine emotion as the foundation of morality, opposing hypocritical Neo-Confucian pretensions ('outwardly advocating Dao learning, inwardly coveting wealth'); M05 Liberation Method — freeing thought from Confucian dogma and ritual constraints, advocating intellectual freedom and personal expression; M06 Practical Verification Method — testing truth through real-world utility and practical effectiveness rather than textual dogma ('those who speak not of finance cannot govern'); M07 Individuality Method — affirming each person's unique value, opposing standardized personality molding (independent-minded, daring to commit suicide to preserve conviction); M08 Equality Method — denying the natural legitimacy of social hierarchy, advocating gender equality and sameness of scholars and commoners (praising Wu Zetian as 'sage empress,' affirming Zhuo Wenjun's choice of a worthy husband); M09 Natural Law Method — conforming to human nature ('self-interest is the mind of humanity'), opposing asceticism; M10 Anti-Tradition Method — questioning and subverting all established authority (Confucius-Mencius classics, Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism), replacing conservatism with a dynamic historical worldview ('progressive with the times'). These ten modes collectively form Li Zhi's unique intellectual system: starting from childlike mind, grounded in material practice, positioned as heterodox, standardized by authenticity, aiming for liberation, methodologically empirical, expressing individuality, principled in equality, natural in instinct, weaponized as anti-tradition. Five unique characteristics: critical precedence (starting from critique rather than positive construction), material ontology (bringing Dao back to daily survival), heterodox consciousness (actively embracing marginal identity), authenticity ethics (inner sincerity as moral standard), dynamic historicism ('progressive with the times' replacing classic eternalism). Three breakthrough innovations: ten-dimensional critical system (complete logical chain from childlike mind to anti-tradition), late Ming enlightenment pioneer (directly influencing the Yuan brothers and Tang Xianzu, indirectly affecting Yoshida Shoin and the May Fourth Movement), systematic heterodox methodology (theorizing critique itself). He is the only thinker in Protreptic who systematically methodologized 'anti-tradition,' serving as the core case study for critical thinking and intellectual liberation in the knowledge system.
famous_quote: 童心者，绝假纯真，最初一念之本心也
historical_significance: 李贽是晚明思想启蒙运动的核心人物，被誉为中国走向近现代的先行者。他以'异端'自居，系统批判程朱理学和传统儒家权威，开创了以'童心'为核心的思想解放体系。其'穿衣吃饭即是人伦物理'的朴素唯物主义命题，从根本上颠覆了宋明理学的超越性伦理。李贽的思想对袁宗道、袁宏道、袁中道（公安派）产生直接影响，对日本江户时代思想家吉田松阴影响深远，黄仁宇在《万历十五年》中专论其悲剧意义。他的批判精神为五四新文化运动提供了重要思想资源。
